scope: Tracks enum variants and tuple/record payload shapes for every public enum in src/syntax/arena.rs and src/syntax/node.rs; registry builtin type labels and type/parameter enums; semantic, lowered, indexed type, control, and effect enum schemas; the live LoweredValue enum and exactly-one encoded, alias, custom, or rejected codec route for every variant; effect and stream-stage companion tables; managed-resource enums and complete rule rows; raw instruction, pattern, driver, value, and pipeline-stage schemas, including payload types, ordinals, exclusions, and routing metadata. It excludes full grammar productions, arbitrary dynamic declarations, host behavior, and proof/conformance results. Additional derived owners cover runtime Value and ResultValue, LiteralConstant, Validation, closed RuntimeOp identities, checked callable construction and compatibility plus indexed signature encoding, stream parameter types/defaults/validations and callable policy, indexed ID/sentinel/range/location layouts, and TypeTag payload/pool classification. New owner rows state their derivation and boundary explicitly. The inventory remains provisional and makes no G0b freeze, semantic proof, full grammar, Rust conformance, or host-behavior claim.

ir.values.derivation: Codec rows are parsed and reconciled with every live LoweredValue variant; custom row procedures are retained verbatim as normalized tokens.
ir.values.boundary: Covers persistent value codec routing, including Set encode/decode/verify procedures; it does not prove codec soundness or runtime semantics.

ir.lowered_value.derivation: Variant payload types are encoded as unambiguous token arrays before being reconciled with codec routes.
ir.lowered_value.boundary: Describes lowered values and payload types only; lowering behavior and codec correctness are not proved.

runtime.value.derivation: Rust enum variants and tuple/record payload types, parsed from the declaration.
runtime.value.boundary: Describes the runtime value algebra only; it does not inventory evaluator behavior or prove source semantics.

runtime.result_value.derivation: Rust enum variants and payload types, parsed from the declaration.
runtime.result_value.boundary: Describes the runtime result container only; it does not inventory error propagation behavior.

constants.literal.derivation: Rust enum variants and payload types, parsed from the declaration.
constants.literal.boundary: Covers bounded prepared constants, not which expressions evaluate to constants or their evaluation semantics.

types.validation.derivation: Rust enum variants and payload types, parsed from the declaration.
types.validation.boundary: Covers validation identities only; validity rules and preservation behavior remain separate semantics.

types.runtime_op.derivation: All RuntimeOp variants are parsed in declaration order from the closed Rust enum.
types.runtime_op.boundary: Covers operation identities only; API registration, dispatch, and host effects are outside this inventory.

types.callable_contract.derivation: Named struct fields and normalized token bodies of the checked callable construction and compatibility rules.
types.callable_contract.boundary: Pins current source-level signature rules; it is not a proof that call lowering or runtime dispatch conforms.

stream.parameters.derivation: Parameter enum variants, record fields, default constant, and normalized stage-configuration and callable-policy functions.
stream.parameters.boundary: Covers registry declarations and policy tables only; stream execution and delayed-effect charging are outside this inventory.

ir.indexed_ids.derivation: The sentinel, ID-generating macro body, and every macro invocation are parsed from their declarations.
ir.indexed_ids.boundary: Describes the current nonzero, one-based ID encoding and sentinel; it does not prove every decoder checks bounds.

ir.indexed_ranges.derivation: IrData, IrRange, IrLocation field layouts and the range-bound and span-conversion methods are parsed from Rust.
ir.indexed_ranges.boundary: Covers compact indexed offsets and locations only; broader source-map behavior and verifier checks are excluded.

source.locations.derivation: SourceId, Span, and SourceLocation field layouts plus span constructor and range methods are parsed from Rust.
source.locations.boundary: Covers byte-offset representation and local span operations only; source loading and diagnostics are not modeled.

types.indexed_pool_schema.boundary: Records the current pool encoding and classification source; it does not establish a verified round trip or semantic preservation.
